description:
The Marathi Drama Competition ‘A’ & ‘B’ Group is an initiative launched by the Government of Maharashtra. 

This scheme was introduced in 2018. 

The primary objective of this competition is to promote Marathi theatre. 

It aims to encourage local talent in acting, directing, and scriptwriting. 

The competition is designed for amateur theatre groups. 

It provides a platform for these groups to showcase their skills. 

The competition is divided into two categories: Group ‘A’ and Group ‘B’. 

Group ‘A’ consists of professional theatre groups. 

Group ‘B’ is meant for amateur theatre groups. 

The competition is held annually. 

The Maharashtra State Cultural Affairs Department oversees the implementation of this scheme. 

The competition is open to all theatre groups registered in Maharashtra. 

The eligibility criteria for participation in Group ‘A’ include having a minimum of five performances. 

For Group ‘B’, the theatre group must not have performed more than five plays. 

The competition encourages participation from diverse age groups. 

There are no specific age limits for participants. 

However, the groups must consist of a minimum of five members. 

The competition aims to promote the Marathi language through theatre. 

It also seeks to foster cultural heritage and traditions. 

The winners of the competition receive cash prizes. 

The cash prize for Group ‘A’ is ₹1,00,000. 

The cash prize for Group ‘B’ is ₹50,000. 

In addition to cash prizes, winners receive certificates of merit. 

The competition also provides opportunities for further exposure. 

Winners may be invited to perform at state-level festivals. 

The application process for the competition is straightforward. 

Interested theatre groups must submit an application form. 

The application form can be obtained from the Maharashtra State Cultural Affairs Department's official website. 

The application must include details about the group and its members. 

The application must also include a synopsis of the play to be performed. 

The deadline for submitting applications is usually set in July each year. 

Once the applications are received, a preliminary selection is conducted. 

Selected groups are then invited to perform in the competition. 

The performances are judged by a panel of experts. 

The judging panel typically consists of experienced theatre professionals. 

Judges evaluate performances based on various criteria. 

These criteria include acting, direction, script, and overall presentation. 

The competition is held in multiple rounds. 

The first round consists of preliminary performances. 

The top groups from the preliminary round advance to the finals. 

The final performances are usually held in August. 

The exact dates for the finals are announced after the preliminary round. 

The competition also aims to promote teamwork and collaboration among participants. 

It encourages groups to work together to create a cohesive performance. 

The scheme has seen participation from numerous theatre groups across the state. 

In the last edition, over 100 groups participated in the competition. 

The competition has received positive feedback from participants and audiences alike. 

It has helped in reviving interest in Marathi theatre. 

The scheme also promotes cultural exchange among different regions of Maharashtra. 

The Maharashtra State Cultural Affairs Department can be contacted for further information. 

Their official website provides updates and details about the competition. 

The department's contact number is available on the website for inquiries. 

The competition has also been instrumental in discovering new talent. 

Many participants have gone on to pursue careers in theatre and film. 

The scheme has contributed to the growth of the Marathi theatre scene. 

It has also fostered a sense of community among theatre enthusiasts. 

The competition is part of a broader initiative to promote arts and culture in Maharashtra. 

The government allocates a budget specifically for this competition each year. 

In 2022, the budget for the competition was ₹50 lakh. 

This budget covers prizes, promotional activities, and operational costs. 

The competition also collaborates with local cultural organizations. 

These collaborations help in reaching a wider audience. 

The scheme has been successful in attracting sponsorships from local businesses. 

These sponsorships provide additional funding for the competition. 

The Marathi Drama Competition ‘A’ & ‘B’ Group is a significant cultural event. 

It plays a crucial role in preserving and promoting Marathi culture. 

The competition not only showcases talent but also educates audiences about theatre. 

It encourages creativity and artistic expression among participants. 

Overall, the Marathi Drama Competition ‘A’ & ‘B’ Group is a vital initiative. 

It supports the growth of the arts in Maharashtra. 

The competition continues to evolve and adapt to the needs of the community. 

It remains committed to fostering a vibrant theatre culture in the state. 

This initiative exemplifies the government's dedication to cultural development. 

The competition is a testament to the rich heritage of Marathi theatre. 

It serves as a beacon for aspiring artists in the region. 

The scheme has successfully created a platform for artistic collaboration. 

It encourages the exploration of contemporary themes through traditional mediums. 

The Marathi Drama Competition ‘A’ & ‘B’ Group is a celebration of creativity and talent.
